about: A checker command in a pure && chain is credited with its lane, with env assignments before it and a redirection after it, whose exit status stays the command's

scripts.test:policies:push: CANOPI_SKIP_BUNDLED_DB=1 RUST_LOG=warn node ../../policy/check.mjs --self-test --lane push 2>&1 && CANOPI_SKIP_BUNDLED_DB=1 node ../../policy/check.mjs --lane=push >out.log
